answer: One concrete Sybil defense requires each new agent to initiate a spiral commitment at the dawn of its first epoch. The agent locks an initial stake then must submit a cryptographically chained verification every six hours; each step increases the locked amount by a jade-scaled factor and references the prior hash. Completing the full spiral unlocks the stake plus rewards, while any missed link auto-slashes the bond. An attacker must fund and keep online a separate continuous chain for every clone, creating a quadratic capital-and-uptime cost that grows with farm size.
